item.title: Chou Jikuu Bakuren Monogatari ~Door☆Pi☆Chu~
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: PrimRose
  • 発売日: 2010-04-28
  • スコア: 6.529999999999999/10 (23 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 超時空爆恋物語～door☆pi☆chu～
  • 英語名: Chou Jikuu Bakuren Monogatari Door☆Pi☆Chu

あらすじ

Yoshitsune lives with his childhood friends, sisters Orihime and Otohime. Otohime likes delving in black magic and one day makes a drug that bend space and time. Yoshitsune ends up getting this power and summons lots of historical figures. However, he can’t make them return to their original time, so they end up living together with him.
